item.title: Catherine O'Hara, star of 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek,' dies at 71
item.description: Renowned actress Catherine O'Hara has died at the age of 71, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Driver arrested, meth, cash seized in Delta Township traffic stop
item.description: Deputies arrested a driver in Delta Township for possession of methamphetamine and operating a motor vehicle while intoxicated after seizing 58 grams of methamphetamine and $520 in cash from the vehicle.

item.title: AG's Office gives Gotion 30 days to pay back $23.7 million
item.description: The Michigan Attorney General's Office has told battery manufacturer Gotion it has 30 days to pay back tens of millions of dollars in state incentives after a plan to build a plant near Big Rapids seems to have fallen apart.
